def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    import numpy as np
    
    node_attrs = graph.nodes
    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    avg_degree = pre.get('avg_degree', 1)
    
    betw = np.array([node_attrs[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    eig = np.array([node_attrs[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    clust = np.array([node_attrs[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    core = np.array([node_attrs[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    degree = np.array([node_attrs[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    
    def normalize(arr):
        mn, mx = np.min(arr), np.max(arr)
        if abs(mx - mn) < 1e-9:
            return np.full_like(arr, 0.5)
        return (arr - mn) / (mx - mn)
    
    betw_n = normalize(betw) + 1e-9
    eig_n = normalize(eig) + 1e-9
    inv_clust_n = normalize(1 - clust) + 1e-9
    core_n = normalize(core) + 1e-9
    
    # Adaptive weights shifting emphasis from early disruption (betw, inv_clust) to stability (core)
    w_early = 0.45
    w_core = 0.1
    w_eig = 0.35
    w_inv_clust = 0.45
    
    # Geometric mean weighted score (log-space for numerical stability)
    # score = (betw^w_early) * (eig^w_eig) * (inv_clust^w_inv_clust) * (core^w_core)
    log_score = (w_early * np.log(betw_n) + 
                 w_eig * np.log(eig_n) + 
                 w_inv_clust * np.log(inv_clust_n) + 
                 w_core * np.log(core_n))
    scores = np.exp(log_score)
    
    # Penalize very high degree nodes mildly to avoid hubs dominating early but keep them considered
    degree_n = normalize(degree)
    penalty = np.exp(-degree_n)  # decays with degree
    
    final_scores = scores * penalty
    
    idx = np.argmax(final_scores)
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[idx]
    return next_node
